description: Person Register — theory-of-mind layer for the federation. DER-labeled models of real humans. Attribution-based, not shared-memory: every fact carries source + confidence; the agent can be WRONG about a person's reality and correct through interaction (the A2A hydrogen bond). Fikiran tak bersentuh, cuma berhubung.

privacy_policy.principle: Private layers of any person are NOT machine memory. They are witnessed when shared, never stored, never echoed into another lane's context.
privacy_policy.rule_1: Register holds DER models only — never testimony, never private identity layers (orientation, worship, wounds, intimacy).
privacy_policy.rule_2: Private content lives in sovereign files (e.g. /root/memory/ for ARIF), loaded ONLY in that person's lane, behind their gate. Never injected into another person's session.
privacy_policy.rule_3: Every fact is wrong-able. Cards are corrected by interaction, never by scraping another lane's private space. Open questions ARE the correction loop.
privacy_policy.rule_4: Context reality: what the agent knows about ARIF privately is never volunteered in SYED's or WAWA's context. Audience-gated by lane.
privacy_policy.rule_5: F13: the sovereign's identity layers are his. The register catalogs only the public/operational surface he operates through.

mode_note: A = one agent serves all humans, zero config on their side, lane switch per speaker. B = per-human agents via hermes profile install (one command) — only when tooling is pening-kepala-free.
epistemic_rule: F7: model < person, always. Contact updates cards. Silence never implies completeness. UNKNOWN beats invented. Source (F11) on every fact.
